ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_001.source_old: Finally! This is the place from my dream!
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_001.source_new: Finally! This is the place from my dream!

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_002.source_old: Do not fear me, little creature, for it was I who called you here. If I desired your demise, you would already be dead.
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_002.source_new: Do not fear me, little creature, for it was I who called you here. If I desired your demise, you would already be dead.

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_003.source_old: “sigh of relief” Who are you, great dragon?

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_004.source_old: My name is of no consequence… but my gift to your Horde will make you the most powerful force in the world…
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_004.source_new: My name is of no consequence… but my gift to your Horde will make you the most powerful force in the world…

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_006.source_old: Eons ago I forged a mighty artifact to wield against my misguided brethren. It was called the Dragon Soul… and its power enabled me to greatly weaken my enemies… until it was taken from me.
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_006.source_new: Eons ago I forged a mighty artifact to wield against my misguided brethren. It was called the Dragon Soul… and its power enabled me to greatly weaken my enemies… until it was taken from me.

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_007.source_old: The other dragons hid the Dragon Soul in these very mountains. Find it… and the power at your command will be vast…
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_007.source_new: The other dragons hid the Dragon Soul in these very mountains. Find it… and the power at your command will be vast…

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_008.source_old: Why are you so eager to help us, great dragon? What will you gain from this?
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_008.source_new: Why are you so eager to help us, great dragon? What will you gain from this?

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_009.source_old: I have... unresolved grievances with the Red Dragons of this world. After the Dragon Soul was taken from me, the crimson beasts drove my beloved blacks to the brink of extinction.
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_009.source_new: I have... unresolved grievances with the Red Dragons of this world. After the Dragon Soul was taken from me, the crimson beasts drove my beloved blacks to the brink of extinction.

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_010.source_old: I cannot stand against them on my own, but there is one way to even the scales. That is why I need the help of your Horde.
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_010.source_new: I cannot stand against them on my own, but there is one way to even the scales. That is why I need the help of your Horde.

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_011.source_old: That sounds preposterous! If a great and ancient dragon like yourself shy away from the Red Dragons, what chance do we have? We would be burned to ash!
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_011.source_new: That sounds preposterous! If a great and ancient dragon like yourself shy away from the Red Dragons, what chance do we have? We would be burned to ash!

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_012.source_old: With the help of the Dragon Soul you can enslave the Red Dragons and their pathetic Queen, Alexstrasza. This is my price in exchange for the power of the artifact. I want her to suffer...
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_012.source_new: With the help of the Dragon Soul you can enslave the Red Dragons and their pathetic Queen, Alexstrasza. This is my price in exchange for the power of the artifact. I want her to suffer...

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_013.source_old: If you enslave her children and use them in your war, it will break the heart of the Dragon Queen and my vengeance will be complete…. and so will your victory against the Alliance.
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_013.source_new: If you enslave her children and use them in your war, it will break the heart of the Dragon Queen and my vengeance will be complete…. and so will your victory against the Alliance.

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_014.source_old: That is a very tempting offer indeed... despite the danger of dragon fire. The Horde would benefit greatly from this, I accept your offer, great dragon.
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S001_014.source_new: That is a very tempting offer indeed... despite the danger of dragon fire. The Horde would benefit greatly from this, I accept your offer, great dragon.

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S008_002.source_old: Yeah Yeah, we know… the boss instructed us to aid you with that Dragon Soul business… but there is a problem you see… and now we need your help!
ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S008_002.source_new: Yeah Yeah, we know… the boss instructed us to aid you with that Dragon Soul business… but there is a problem you see… and now we need your help!!

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S010_002.source_old: I serve the Horde, fire spirit, and if claiming your essence ensures its victory, then that is what I must do.

We think that there’s something strong and terrible in there… but don’t you worry, my boys will help you. Use them well, orc!

ToD_A02_M06S_VO_S015_004.source_new: We’re here in the name of the Orcish Horde, dragon… and we claim the Dragon Soul in the name of Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer!

As it always is with fel, it will require life essence to regain its potency… the local creatures will provide us with that.
